notes.title: Git Gud Contest [Winner Gets $1000]
notes.content:
Beat the final level on Git Gud - Join the Competition!

The competition starts on release day June 18th 10:00 AM PDT, and it’s your chance to show your skills. Complete Level 12 in the full game $3.99 USD and claim your spot among the winners!  

Prizes: 
💰 1st Place: $1000  
💰 2nd Place: $500  
💰 3rd Place: $250  
💰 4th–20th Place: $50 each  
💰 21st-40th Place: $25 each  

*Prizes will be sent in USD via PayPal, gift cards, or a preferred method. 

How to Enter:
1️⃣ Complete Level 12: Finish the level in the full game (not the demo).  

2️⃣ Record Your Run:  
   Upload an unedited video of your completion to platforms like:  
   - YouTube (set to public or unlisted)  
   - Twitch VOD (make sure it doesn’t expire)  
   - Kick, Facebook Gaming, or similar platforms with timestamps.  

3️⃣ Share Your Entry:  
   Post your video in the Steam Git Gud community with the title:  
   "Git Gud Champion: [Your Name] – Level 12 Completion"
   Make sure the video upload date matches the date of your post.  

Rules to Keep It Fair:  
✅ Only Level 12 needs to be recorded—no full-game footage required.  
✅ No game speed changes (e.g., speed hacks).  
✅ No tools like Cheat Engine or anything that alters physics or gameplay.  
✅ Your footage must be unedited and continuous (no cuts).  
✅ One prize per person/IP. Multiple accounts will be disqualified.  

We’ll review the first 20 valid submissions, so don’t miss your chance to participate.  

Wishlist the game now to know when it launches, and start practicing in the demo to stay ahead of the game. 🎮  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3305620/Git_Gud_Demo/

Catch you soon,  
Sam
